Life without a car just keeps getting better & better.  If I can't cycle somewhere, I'll take a bus. Very rarely, if I actually really need a car and can't borrow one, I'll hire one.
I spend a lot less time worrying about cars now that I don't own one. Plus I am being financially rewarded for not screwing the planet. Cycling means  no problems with traffic, parking, drink-driving, garages, insurance, vandalism, theft, maintenance, fuel, licensing, depreciation, etc. All of that grief gets swapped for a little exercise that keeps you healthy. So you save on gym membership as well as all the car-related expenses.
When I was pondering how best to replace my last car; petrol? Diesel? Electric? New or used? Mileage? I thought I'd take my time to make sure I made the right decision. As time went on, the realisation dawned that for myself and most other people and for the planet, owning a car at all is the stupidest option.
